visual: Large glossy split leaves · irregular cream and yellow-white variegation · speckled like stars
soilWarning: No cold or harsh sun · needs good light
prune: Remove damaged leaves at the base; cut aerial roots only where necessary
toxicity: Harmful if eaten · calcium oxalate irritates mouth and gut
hardinessNote: Tender tropical; indoors or heated protection in the UK
resilience: easy indoors when warm, humid and well lit · intolerant of frost
uses: houseplant · conservatory · heated greenhouse · tropical indoor displays
uncertain: Second Monstera after the plain species; the variegation is the only difference a customer will see
